svg.title: cohors overview, then a dry run
svg.desc:
$ cohors overview
▜▒▟███▙▒▛ cohors ▟██▌█▐██▙ 13 repositories. 6 have work at risk, 2 are clean. ▀▐▖▀█▀▗▌▀ ~/code
Do next most urgent first; the command under each step starts it RISK Push 4 commits from 3 repositories They exist only on this machine: analytics, design-system and payments. Some are more than 2 days old. cohors push --select 'ahead,!diverged' WARN Reconcile 1 diverged branch Local and remote both moved, so neither a push nor a fast-forward pull will work: mobile-app. cohors scan --select diverged …
$ cohors push --select ahead --dry-run
▜▒▟███▙▒▛ cohors ▟██▌█▐██▙ push: git push across the repos you pick ▀▐▖▀█▀▗▌▀ never force-pushes, so remote history stays safe
Dry run would push 4 repos, nothing will change ▸ mobile-app ~/code/mobile-app ▸ payments ~/code/payments ▸ design-system ~/code/design-system ▸ analytics ~/code/analytics
